description: Slotsgade runs straight away under lime trees, with low brick houses and white windows, and a pale manor closes the far end. The night is overcast, about 10.7°C, with wind near 5.8 km/h, and the cobbles are empty. The late-September limes are still mostly green. This street is in Møgeltønder, about four kilometres west of Tønder.
